component.name: audio.cpp (CPU)
component.summary: Run local audio AI models with the CPU backend

description.p: Run speech synthesis, speech recognition, voice conversion and music generation locally with audio.cpp. This community package uses the unmodified official CPU portable Linux release.

The launcher starts a local server in a terminal; the package has no native application window. Open http://127.0.0.1:8080 in your browser to use its embedded WebUI. Close the server with Ctrl+C. Models and voices are stored in this app's private data directory. Model weights have their own licenses.

This package includes the native model manager in the server. Workflows requiring Python conversion or additional host tools are unavailable. CPU and Vulkan editions use separate model stores and ports.

For command line inference use flatpak run --command=audio-cpp-cli io.github._0xShug0.AudioCpp.CPU. To access an existing models folder, grant it with flatpak override --user --filesystem=/path/to/models:ro io.github._0xShug0.AudioCpp.CPU. Undo custom grants with flatpak override --user --reset io.github._0xShug0.AudioCpp.CPU.
